<!-- pr-reviewer: fa53fdf1c679ab90f76e623b3d3c7ac1fd57b613 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The stock now covers the part in all three test fixtures. The quarter-turn rotation is kept. The tests still check the operation's gouge warnings and confirm that a blocked post does not write a file. The change meets issue #1608.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream/main at e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90:
- Build: the three test suites compiled with `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test circular_entity_law --test circular_pick_law --test trochoid_law --no-run`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. circular_entity_law: 5 passed; circular_pick_law: 5 passed; trochoid_law: 7 passed. No tests failed or were ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety checks: I repeated two mutation checks. I restored the old `job()` function from upstream/main in trochoid_law and circular_pick_law, one at a time. Each new bounds test failed with this result:
```
stock at Point3 { x: -40.0, y: -40.0, z: 0.0 }..Point3 { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 8.0 }
```
Each test passed after I restored the reviewed file. The worktree has no file changes.

Requested changes: none.

Notes: This change affects safety test fixtures only. It does not change production code, posted G-code, dependencies, or UI files. No golden files changed. The full release gate was not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
